primitives.name: Bounded Integration Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Start in docs or a sandbox and only move into app code after explicit approval.
primitives.assumptions: Integration is gated by explicit A=1; T is measured from sandbox activation to code commit.
primitives.breakdown_regime: G = 1 iff A = 1; T is minimized for efficiency.
